purpose: Inputs of the pinned validateAgeTemple run for the Temple probe's GLOBAL node (Wallmaster limits design, Stage 2): run_pinned_entrance_pools.mts --temple builds each group's world with no starting warp song and with each OoT warp song alone, and records OoTMM's answer, what each age reached and the songless walks. temple-song-facts.json holds the recorded run.

dekuTreeOpen.note: OoTMM's default dekuTree open (data.ts:1194), the port's Closed Forest Off (ComboPresets.h).

dekuTreeClosed.note: dekuTree closed, the port's Closed Forest Deku Only, as the Beginner preset sets it (presets.ts:977).

closedForest.note: Crafted: the port's Closed Forest On, which OoTMM does not have. Ship's Kokiri Forest exit to the Lost Woods bridge needs an adult or the Deku Tree beaten (kokiri_forest.cpp:125); with starting items only the child cannot beat it, so the crafted exit is adult only. Ship forces a child start with it (settings.cpp), so this world is a probe test, not a seed the port makes with an adult start.

closedForestForeignSongs.note: The crafted Closed Forest with the port's "Play warp songs across games", OoTMM's songSoaringOot and song*Mm (ComboPresets.h): the MM warp songs and Soaring in OoT exist, none at the start (lemma S1).

closedForestMasterQuest.note: The crafted Closed Forest with every OoT dungeon Master Quest (mqDungeons, all twelve), as the songs-v2 id admits from OoTMM's bundled data.

none.note: No ocarina; the buttons are not shuffled.

ocarina.note: The Fairy Ocarina; the buttons are not shuffled, so every note plays (macros_oot.yml:17).

buttons.note: Ocarina buttons shuffled (OoT) and all five at the start.

noCLeft.note: Ocarina buttons shuffled (OoT) and every one but C-Left at the start: Bolero and Requiem still play.

sharedNoCDown.note: Shared ocarina buttons (both games shuffled) and every shared one but C-Down at the start.
